beats.speaker: ulric
beats.text: Hakon. They said what they did. Frosthollow said it, out loud, at the Lamp and Pick.

beats.speaker: ulric
beats.text: You know me, then. I kept the stones, brother. Every one.

beats.speaker: ulric
beats.text: What now?

options.label: Let them go over the Pass.
Take the Captain to the city.

beats.speaker: ulric
beats.text: Then it is done. Lamp lit, cousin. The howl is coming.

beats.speaker: herald
beats.text: The Moot sits. I read every voice as it came in off the Line, and I read them as they came.

beats.speaker: roll
beats.text: The roll is open. Every voice, as it comes. The Council will hear it whether it likes it or not.

beats.speaker: purse
beats.text: Count the voices, by all means. I've already counted mine.

beats.speaker: eye
beats.text: She is listening, honoured guest. She has not yet decided this realm is worth it.

beats.speaker: herald
beats.text: The free wolves of the roads have their own voice at the Moot. Which way does the square howl?

options.label: For the Moot itself, and no crown.

beats.speaker: herald
beats.text: That is the square's howl. The roll is counted. Hear the Moot's verdict.

beats.speaker: herald
beats.text: The Moot has howled for the Blood. Ottilie Harrowgate, the realm asks you to reign.

beats.speaker: heir
beats.text: If the realm wants a Harrowgate, it shall have one who carries her own petitions.

beats.speaker: lamp
beats.text: And somebody ought to keep the lamp lit while she does. I know the stairs, no?

beats.speaker: herald
beats.text: The Moot has howled for the Lamp. The lamp-keeper of the Palace is the realm's choice.

beats.speaker: lamp
beats.text: I'll stand. Not for the chair. For the round, no? And the first thing the round needs is a waystation at the crossroads.

beats.speaker: sergeant
beats.text: Then I'm your sergeant. Don't make a speech of it.

beats.speaker: roll
beats.text: No crown, then. The Moot keeps the realm, and it sits again every winter. The herald speaks for it.

beats.speaker: herald
beats.text: Speaker of the Moot. A herald who is allowed to answer back. I will read every voice again next time.

beats.speaker: lamp
beats.text: And I'll keep the lamp for the Moot. Same lamp. More stairs.

beats.speaker: purse
beats.text: The realm is in good order. It owes, and it knows it. My daughter will sit the chair.

beats.speaker: heir
beats.text: Crowned for a sum I didn't add. I'll audit the crown first, Father.

beats.speaker: lamp
beats.text: Next Moot, howl louder. I mean every one of you.

scenes.title: The drowned bell at the Bay Light

beats.speaker: priest
beats.text: The howl is in. Count a hundred breaths after the bell, and the far howls come in after it.

beats.speaker: priest
beats.text: For the drowned, and for every voice that carried it here. Bright One keep them.

beats.speaker: reader
beats.text: I never answered it. I read it every winter. I think I will read it once more here, and then let the water have it.

beats.speaker: reader
beats.text: There. It is gone. That was meant to hurt more than it did, no?

quests.title: Keep a post on the Moot night

quests.title: A Late Howl
